title: NURENBERGER HERCULES-WERK: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (1,500 affected)
summary: SOME MOPEDS MAY NOT BE EQUIPPED WITH REARVIEW MIRRORS AS REQUIRED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 111, "REARVIEW MIRRORS".

title: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (2,600 affected)
summary: TIRES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THE INVOLVED TIRES MAY DEVELOP SEPARATIONS IN THE SHOULDER AREA IN USAGE.

title: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES:BEAD (300 affected)
summary: THE PLIES THAT TIE THE BEAD INTO THE TIRE MAY HAVE BEEN TOO NARROW. THIS CONDITION COULD RESULT IN BREAKING OF THE TIRE IN THE BEAD AREA AND SUBSEQUENT INNER TUBE FAILURE WITH LOSS OF AIR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:LINKAGES (4,200 affected)
summary: INCORRECT STEERING LINKAGE COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES. THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH LIGHT DUTY STEERING LINKAGE TIE ROD AND CENTER LINK ASSEMBLIES IN PLACE OF THE SPECIFIED HEAVY DUTY COMPONENTS. THESE LIGHT DUTY COMPONENTS ARE NOT COMPATIBLE FOR ATTACHMENT TO THE HEAVY DUTY KNUCKLE ARMS, RESULTING IN AN INFLEXIBLE (NO BALL JOINT MOVEMENT) ATTACHMENT OF THE TIE ROD TO KNUCKLE ARM. THIS COULD, EVENTUALLY, RESULT IN FATIGUE FAILURE OF THAT ATTACHMENT ON ONE OF THE COMPONENTS.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (61,000 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES CONTAIN A POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE PRESSURE CONTROL VALVE IN THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM WHICH, THROUGH EXCESS PRESSURE OVER EXTENDED PERIODS, COULD CAUSE METAL FATIGUE AND EVENTUALLY FUEL VAPORS TO BE EMITTED INTO THE ATMOSPHERE THROUGH HAIRLINE CRACKS IN THE FUEL TANK.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (197 affected)
summary: DURING SURVEILLANCE TESTING, TIRES DEVELOPED SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AND TREAD AREA WHEN OPERATED IN AN OVERLOADED OR UNDERINFLATED CONDITION.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:CORD (427 affected)
summary: THE WRONG PLY CORD WAS USED IN PRODUCTION. THIS MAY CAUSE CRACKING BETWEEN THE PLY CORDS.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (4,535 affected)
summary: WHEN TIRES WERE OPERATED IN AN UNDERINFLATED OR OVERINFLATED CONDITION, THEY DEVELOPED SEPARATIONS IN THE SHOULDER AREA AND TREAD AREA DURING A SURVEILLANCE TEST.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (234 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109,"NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THESE TIRES MAY DEVELOP CRACKS IN THE TREAD GROOVES. THIS COULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE THE PLY CORDS TO BREAK AND THE TUBELESS INNER LINER TO TEAR AND LOSE AIR.

title: SHELLER-GLOBE CORPORATION: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT:MATERIAL (3,695 affected)
INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS AND PUMP (4,300 affected)
summary: DUE TO INCORRECT CLIPPING OF THE FUEL LINE AT THE RIGHT FRONT INNER FENDER SPLASH PANEL, THE LINE COULD SEVER OR BECOME PARTIALLY CUT BY THE LOWER EDGE OF THE SPLASH PANEL, IN THE EVENT OF A VEHICLE IMPACT. THESE VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: WHEELS:MULTIPLE:DISC:SPIDER (9,700 affected)
summary: A CASTING DEFICIENCY MAY ALLOW WHEELS TO DEVELOP CRACKS IN THE SPOKES BETWEEN THE HUB CAP MOUNTING AREA AND THE RIM CLAMP POCKET. CONTINUED USAGE CAN LEAD TO THE DISENGAGING OF THE RIM AND TIRE FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: VESELY COMPANY: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (20 affected)
summary: DUE TO IMPROPER WIRING, A 110 VOLT CIRCUIT IS NOT PROTECTED BY A CIRCUIT BREAKER. IF THE UNIT IS CONNECTED TO AN UNPROTECTED POWER SOURCE, A SHORT CIRCUIT CAN RESULT.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (16,000 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECT STEERING GEAR FLANGE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED, WHICH MAY SLIP AND CAUSE EVENTUAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (1,100 affected)
summary: THE AIR BRAKE LINES MAY BE ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MUFFLER. BECAUSE THE AIR BRAKE LINES ARE MADE OF NYLON MATERIAL, HEAT FROM THE EXHAUST MUFFLER CAN WEAKEN THE BRAKE LINE TUBES, POSSIBLY CAUSING THEM TO RUPTURE. TUBE RUPTURE COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF AIR IN THE SECONDARY AIR BRAKE SYSTEM.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (543 affected)
summary: SURVEILLANCE TESTING SHOWED THAT SOME TIRES WOULD DEVELOP SEPARATION IN THE TREAD AREA WHEN OPERATED IN AN OVERLOADED OR UNDERINFLATED CONDITION.

title: OLSON BODIES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT (3,000 affected)
summary: THE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY CONTAIN THE WRONG TYPE OF LOCK NUT AT THE ATTACHMENT TO THE DRIVER"S SEAT. THIS CAN ALLOW THE LOCK NUT AND SEAT BELT TO SEPARATE UNDER NORMAL VEHICLE VIBRATION OR FROM FORCE EXERTED BY THE WEARER.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:VALVE:CONTROL (2,620 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE VALVES MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY PIPED. IF THE PARKING BRAKE PIPING IS INCORRECTLY ROUTED, THERE IS NO WAY TO SET THE TRACTOR PARKING BRAKES INDEPENDENTLY OF THE TRAILER PARKING BRAKES. THIS COULD CAUSE THE PARKING BRAKES TO BACK OFF WHILE THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY IS BEING CHARGED, CAUSING THE TRACTOR TO ROLL.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (164 affected)
summary: LABELS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS". INCORRECT INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED ON TIRE LABELS.

title: AMERICAN TRAILERS, INC.: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS (125 affected)
summary: THE REAR LOWER FRAME SUPPORTING MEMBER MAY EXPERIENCE FATIGUE FAILURE DUE TO THE SUBSTITUTION OF INFERIOR ALUMINUM ALLOY. THESE CRACKS COULD TRAVEL THE ENTIRE LENGTH OF THE BUCK PLATE.

title: FIAT MOTORS OF N.A., INC.: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (1,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL LINES FROM THE FUEL TANK MAY CONTACT THE METAL EDGE OF A HOLE IN THE BULKHEAD, WHICH CAN RESULT IN DAMAGE TO THE FUEL LINES. IF THE FUEL LINES ARE DAMAGED, FUEL COULD LEAK INSIDE THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (193 affected)
summary: THE REAR SEAT BELT STALK COULD BECOME DETACHED WHEN IN USE DUE TO IMPROPER HEAT PROCESSING DURING MANUFACTURE.

title: FIAT MOTORS OF N.A., INC.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (37,260 affected)
summary: A PLASTIC TUBE COVERING PART OF THE METAL BRAKE LINE FOR THE REAR BRAKE SYSTEM MAY ALLOW WATER TO ACCUMULATE. THIS WATER WILL OXIDIZE THE BRAKE LINE. OXIDATION CAN CAUSE DETERIORATION OR POSSIBLE BREAKAGE OF THE BRAKE LINE. THIS CAN RESULT IN A LOSS OF EFFICIENCY OF THE REAR BRAKE SYSTEM AND CAN IMPAIR THE TOTAL BRAKING CAPACITY OF THE VEHICLE.
